appsList.notes: Password manager by AgileBits (Android com.onepassword.android, iOS com.1password.1password). Store title 1Password: Password Manager. Predecessor iOS app 1Password 7 is com.agilebits.onepassword-ios (id568903335).
IMAP/POP3 email client (Android org.kman.AquaMail, iOS org.kman.aquamail). Play title Email Aqua Mail - Fast, Secure; Apple title Email Aqua Mail Secure Client.
Enterprise secure messaging (Gryphn Corp; Android/iOS co.armortext.messenger). Apple title ArmorText Secure Messenger.
Anonymous Q&A social app (com.askfm). Platform discontinued December 1, 2024; store listings removed.

AVG antivirus/security (Android com.antivirus, iOS com.avg.ios.security). Play title AVG AntiVirus & Security; Apple title AVG Mobile Security. ArtiFast application key AVG; artifacts Android-only. LEAPP modules target the Android vault (com.antivirus).

PDF reader/editor. Android com.adobe.reader; iOS com.adobe.Adobe-Reader. Apple title Acrobat Reader: PDF Editor. ArtiFast covers iOS; ALEAPP covers Android. Distinct from Adobe Scan and Adobe Acrobat Sign.
Alibaba/Taobao instant messenger (阿里旺旺). Standalone app largely discontinued (was com.alibaba.mobileim); messaging often lives in Qianniu/Taobao now. Kept for Cellebrite artifact joins.
Trail maps and recorded hikes/runs by AllTrails, Inc. Android com.alltrails.alltrails; iOS com.alltrails.AllTrails. Store title AllTrails: Hike, Bike & Run.

Retail shopping app by AMZN Mobile LLC. Android com.amazon.mShop.android.shopping; iOS com.amazon.Amazon. Distinct from Alexa, Kindle, Photos, Prime Video, Amazon Business, and Amazon Silk (com.amazon.cloud9).

Chromium-based browser for Fire tablets, Fire TV, and Echo Show (com.amazon.cloud9). Not listed on Apple or Google Play; preinstalled on Fire OS. Oxygen title Amazon browser. Distinct from Amazon Shopping and Amazon Kindle.

Android calculator-disguise photo vault (com.hld.anzenbokusufake). Play title was Calculator - hide photos; vault in .privacy_safe. Disguise of Sgallery (com.hld.anzenbokusu); both delisted. Distinct from AppLock (com.domobile.applockwatcher), Playground Vault, Calculator Lock, and Calculator#.
iOS Clock app (alarms / world clock).
iOS/iPadOS Files app (com.apple.DocumentsApp).
Apple Fitness / Fitness+ app (com.apple.Fitness). Workout GPS LEAPP modules live in Health DB but are labeled Fitness.
iOS/macOS Keychain credential store. User-facing app is Passwords (com.apple.Passwords).

Formerly breadwallet. Android com.breadwallet; iOS org.voisine.breadwallet. Acquired by Coinbase in 2021; wallet functionality sunset ~2022 (Apple listing still present with migrate-to-Coinbase Wallet notice). Play listing removed. Distinct from Coinbase.

Baidu browser family (Android com.baidu.searchbox / com.baidu.browser.inter, iOS com.baidu.BDPhoneBrowser). Play listings removed; historical URL kept for searchbox. iOS title 百度浏览器. Oxygen also covers DU Browser / Browser HD / Mini. Distinct from Baidu Maps and from the main Baidu app (com.baidu.BaiduMobile). ArtiFast artifacts are Android-only.
Coinbase Wallet rebranded to Base App (org.toshi). Distinct from Coinbase exchange (com.coinbase.android). Cellebrite uses spelling “Formally”.
Daily dual-camera social app. Android com.bereal.ft; iOS AlexisBarreyat.BeReal. Apple title BeReal: Photos & Friends Daily; Play title BeReal. Your friends for real.
Beam Privacy Wallet (confidential cryptocurrency). Google Play listing for com.mw.beam.beamwallet.mainnet appears removed as of 2026-07-13.

Delisted nearby-friends messenger (Android com.beetalk, iOS com.garena.BeeTalk). Publisher BeeTalk Private Ltd / BT Mobile; Apple title BeeTalk - Video the Moments. Last Play version 3.0.12 (removed ~May 2019). Cellebrite App Name BeeTalk (legacy Android + iOS). Distinct from Bee Talk Lite (com.beeflirt.beetalk) and BeeTalk LIVE.
iOS Biome / intelligence streams (device & app activity). Not a launcher app; kept for tool artifact joins. CarPlay/Notes-specific streams also remain on those apps.
LEAPP labels BitLord's libretorrent.db as Libretorrent / LibretorrentFR.
Ride-hailing app (ee.mtakso.client). Magnet “Bolt Browser” artifacts are a different product.
Bolt Browser and Documents (com.danyil.boltbrowser). Unrelated to Bolt rideshare.
Hotels and travel app (Android com.booking, iOS com.booking.BookingApp).
Privacy browser (Android com.brave.browser, iOS com.brave.ios.browser). Play title Brave Private Web Browser, VPN; Apple title Brave Browser & Search Engine. ArtiFast application key Brave.

News/quiz app (Android com.buzzfeed.android, iOS com.buzzfeed.buzzfeed). Play title BuzzFeed - Quizzes & News; Apple title BuzzFeed - Quiz, Trivia & News. ArtiFast application key Buzzfeed; artifacts Android-only. Distinct from Tasty and BuzzFeed Quiz Party.

Privacy/VPN web browser by Cake Technologies (Android com.cake.browser). Store title Cake Web Browser. Removed from Google Play; last updates ~2020. ArtiFast artifacts are Android-only. Distinct from Cake Live Stream (com.tangerine.live.cake).
Android calculator-disguised vault (com.calculator.lock.hide.photo.video). Distinct from Calculator#, GalleryVault, and Hide it Pro.
King match-3 game (Android com.king.candycrushsaga, iOS com.midasplayer.apps.candycrushsaga). Distinct from Candy Crush Soda/Jelly/Friends Saga.
Anthropic Claude (com.anthropic.claude). Distinct from ChatGPT. Apple genre is Productivity; catalog uses AI & Assistants to match ChatGPT.
OpenAI ChatGPT app. Android com.openai.chatgpt; iOS com.openai.chat. Distinct from Claude. LEAPP also recovers ChatGPT chats from browser cache (Mister Skinnylegs).
Zynga Chess With Friends (com.zynga.chess.googleplay). Servers shut down Nov 2023; removed from stores. Unrelated apps still use similar names.
Instanza CoCo Messenger (Android com.instanza.cocovoice, iOS com.instanza.CoCo). Removed from stores; last Play update ~2021. Distinct from Coco -Live Stream / Coconut.tv (com.live.juicy).
Encrypted messenger (cm.confide.android). Store listings currently unavailable.
Anonymous chat/social app (C2M; Android com.connected2.ozzy.c2m, iOS com.C2M.Connected2). ArtiFast artifacts are Android-only.
Open-source Android XMPP client (eu.siacs.conversations). Distinct from generic “conversations” artifact names on other messengers.

DJI flight apps clustered here: GO (pre-Phantom 4), GO 4 (Phantom 4/Mavic era), and Fly (current Mini/Air/Mavic). Android dji.pilot / dji.go.v4 / dji.go.v5; iOS com.dji.pilot / com.dji.go / com.dji.golite. Play listings removed; Android Fly is sideloaded from dji.com. LEAPP DAT GPS tracks can also come from DJI Pilot under the same FlightRecord path. Distinct from Litchi and DJI Mimo.

Dahua Technology CCTV/IoT app. Store title DMSS. Android com.mm.android.DMSS; iOS com.cesoftware.dmss. Publisher Hangzhou Dong Bin. LEAPP labels CCTV and IoT modules separately; same app. Distinct from Hik-Connect, DMSS HD, and DMSS VDP.
Video platform (com.dailymotion.dailymotion on Android and iOS). Apple title Dailymotion: Social Videos. ArtiFast artifacts are Android-only.
Google Digital Wellbeing (com.google.android.apps.wellbeing). Android Settings/system app; also on Play. Distinct from Samsung Digital Wellbeing.
ASUS ZenUI task app (com.asus.task). Removed from Google Play in January 2024. Distinct from To Do List (SplenDO), Microsoft To Do, and Todoist.

Cloud storage. Android com.dropbox.android; iOS com.getdropbox.Dropbox. Apple title Dropbox: Cloud Storage Backup. Carousel (com.dropbox.carousel) is the old photos app, mapped here. Distinct from Dropbox Paper, Box, and TeraBox.

Collaborative docs by Dropbox, Inc. Native iOS/Android apps discontinued 2025-10-09; web remains. Android com.dropbox.paper; iOS com.getdropbox.paper. Apple title Paper by Dropbox. Distinct from the Dropbox storage app and from FiftyThree/Evernote Paper.

Eagle Messenger by Beint/Secret Phone (Android com.beint.zangj). Store title Eagle Messenger Video,Audio,Calling; last Play update ~2018. Predecessor lineage to Zangi Messenger (com.beint.zangi). ArtiFast labels application Eagle IM; artifacts Android-only. Distinct from EagleMsgSpy surveillance malware.
Privacy search/browser app (Android com.ecosia.android, iOS com.ecosia.ecosiaapp). Store title Ecosia: Search to plant trees. ArtiFast artifacts are Android-only web activity.

Under Armour GPS fitness tracker (Android com.endomondo.android, iOS com.endomondo.Endomondo). Shut down and removed from stores Dec 31, 2020; UA directed users to Map My Run. Distinct from the unrelated 2024+ Endomondo home-workout apps.
Buyer marketplace app (Android com.etsy.android, iOS com.etsy.etsyforios). Store title Etsy: Shop from Real People. ArtiFast artifacts are Android-only. Distinct from Etsy Seller shop-management app.

Seller shop-management app (Android com.etsy.butter.sell_on_etsy, iOS com.etsy.sellonetsy.butter). Store title Etsy Seller: Manage Your Shop. Distinct from buyer marketplace app Etsy (com.etsy.android / com.etsy.etsyforios).

Event discovery and ticketing app (Android com.eventbrite.attendee, iOS com.eventbrite.attendee). Play title Eventbrite App. ArtiFast artifacts are Android-only. Distinct from Eventbrite Organizer (com.eventbrite.organizer / com.eventbrite.app1).
Event organizer/management app (Android com.eventbrite.organizer, iOS com.eventbrite.app1). Distinct from attendee ticketing app Eventbrite (com.eventbrite.attendee).
Notes and notebook app (Android com.evernote, iOS com.evernote.iPhone.Evernote). Play title Evernote - Note Organizer; Apple title Evernote: AI Notes & Notebook.
Main Facebook app (Android com.facebook.katana, iOS com.facebook.Facebook). ArtiFast application Facebook artifacts are Android-only. Distinct from Facebook Lite and Facebook Messenger.
Lightweight Facebook client (Android com.facebook.lite only; no iOS app). ArtiFast artifacts are Android-only. Distinct from main Facebook app (com.facebook.katana / com.facebook.Facebook).
Apple Find My (com.apple.findmy). Merged Find My Friends (com.apple.mobileme.fmf1) and Find My iPhone (com.apple.mobileme.fmip1). iOS/macOS only; not on Google Play. ArtiFast application key Find My.
Open Garden FireChat mesh/offline messenger (com.opengarden.firechat). Discontinued / removed from stores. Kept for Oxygen/Cellebrite artifact joins.
Privacy-focused companion to Firefox; not the main Firefox browser (org.mozilla.firefox).
Mozilla password manager (mozilla.lockbox / Lockbox). Discontinued December 2021; functionality merged into Firefox. Kept for Oxygen artifact joins.
TextMe, Inc. US/Canada free calling app (iOS bundle com.gemsoftware.textme; Android com.textmeinc.freetone). Distinct from Text Me: Second Number and TextMe Up.

ThinkYeah hide-photos vault. Android com.thinkyeah.galleryvault; iOS com.thinkyeah.iGalleryVault. Apple title GalleryVault -Hide Photo Video; Play title Gallery Vault-Hide Photo Video. Apple genre Photo & Video. Distinct from App Locker, AppLock, Calculator Lock, Playground Vault, and Keepsafe.
Garmin wearable companion (Android com.garmin.android.apps.connectmobile, iOS com.garmin.connect.mobile). Store title Garmin Connect™. ArtiFast application key Garmin.
Formerly GetTaxi (Android com.gettaxi.android, iOS gettaxi.co.uk). Play title is Gett- Corporate Ground Travel. Distinct from Uber/Lyft.

Social network by GETTR USA, Inc. Same package com.gettr.gettr on Android and iOS. Apple title is GETTR - A Marketplace of Ideas. Distinct from Gett Travel and Getcontact. GTok is an in-app video feature, not a separate app.
Android Go / lightweight Gmail (com.google.android.gm.lite). Distinct from Google Mail (Gmail) / com.google.android.gm.
Formerly Android Messages / Messages by Google. Magnet Android SMS/MMS keys include system mmssms.db recovery often used with this app.
Third-party Google Tasks client (Android org.dayup.gtask / DayUp; iOS com.togood.gtasks). Both store listings are gone. Distinct from official Google Tasks.
Calculator-disguise photo/app vault (com.flatfish.cal.privacy). Play Store listing not currently available.
Hikvision end-user CCTV app. LEAPP labels artifacts as Hikvision - CCTV *.

Original Hike Messenger (Android/iOS com.bsb.hike, Hike Private Limited). Later Play title Hike News & Content (v5.15.x); messaging shut Jan 2021, company closed Sep 2025. Cellebrite hike messenger (legacy Android) and Hike messenger (iOS). Distinct from 2025 Hike Messenger Ltd listings (com.tring.messenger / com.hikeapp.messenger).
Store title: The Home Depot (com.thehomedepot / com.thehomedepot.homedepot).
Preinstalled HONOR Gallery / Media Library (com.hihonor.medialibrary). ALEAPP parses gallery.db from that package. Not listed on Apple or Google Play.
Expedia Group hotel booking (Android com.hcom.android, iOS com.hotels.HotelsNearMe). Distinct from Booking.com and Expedia.

Google Play services on-device Icing/AppSearch index (com.google.android.gms icing_contacts.db). Not a launcher app; kept for tool artifact joins. Distinct from Google Contacts and from GMS SMS (icing_mmssms.db).
Workpail notes and checklist app (Android com.workpail.inkpad.notepad.notes; iOS com.workpail.InkPad). Distinct from To Do List (SplenDO) and Apple Reminders.
imo video/chat (Android com.imo.android.imous / com.imo.android.imoim, iOS co.babypenguin.imo). Store title imo video calls and chat HD. ArtiFast application key IMO.

Chromium Android browser with Chrome extension support (com.kiwibrowser.browser). Play title Kiwi Browser - Fast & Quiet. Removed from Play and discontinued ~Jan 2025. ArtiFast application key Kiwi (Android-only). Distinct from Kiwi.com travel and from iOS Kiwi - Browser, Document, VPN (timon.kiwi.go).
iOS/macOS CoreDuet KnowledgeC system database (usage, device state). Not a launcher app; kept for tool artifact joins.
Lidl loyalty app (iOS com.lidl.eci.lidl.plus, Android com.lidl.eci.lidlplus).
Preinstalled MediaTek todos (com.mediatek.todos). Not listed on Apple or Google Play. Distinct from To Do List (SplenDO) and Microsoft To Do.

Sgrouples Inc. social network (formerly Sgrouples). Android and iOS both com.mewe. Apple genre Social Networking. Distinct from MeetMe.
Live video chat (com.mts.meowchat). Distinct from pet-translator apps also named MeowChat. MOBILEdit title appears truncated (“… & M”).

Discontinued iLegendSoft browser. Android com.ilegendsoft.mercury (last Play ~3.2.3). iOS com.ilegendsoft.MBrowser / com.ilegendsoft.MBrowserPro and older com.bsn.mercury / com.bsn.mercurypro. Removed from App Store ~2017. Distinct from the desktop Firefox-fork Mercury Browser. Previous Play URL com.mercurybrowserjv was not this app.
Meta messaging app (Android com.facebook.orca, iOS com.facebook.Messenger). Store title Messenger. ArtiFast application key Facebook Messenger.
Samsung file manager (com.sec.android.app.myfiles).
Streaming app (Android com.netflix.mediaclient, iOS com.netflix.Netflix). ALEAPP-only in the current tool dumps.
Online stranger chat website (not an official store app). Shut down November 2023. Kept for Magnet/Cellebrite artifact joins.
iOS Tor browser (com.miketigas.OnionBrowser). Distinct from Tor Browser and Ornet Browser.
EVO-Vision Oops (com.evovision.oops). Store title has also appeared as Oops: Short Video Dating; Apple US listing currently unavailable.
Play Store title: Dark Web Browser : OrNET.
Free Play package com.orux.oruxmaps removed; Donate listing still active.
Oura Ring companion app (com.ouraring.oura).
Pebble Technology smartwatch companion (Magnet artifacts). Acquired by Fitbit; original store apps delisted. Distinct from climbing apps and the later Core Devices “Pebble Core” revival.
PUMA running/training app (PumaTrac). LEAPP labels artifacts as Puma / Puma-Trac.
Parking payment app (com.verrus.paybyphone / com.paybyphone).
Vault for Apps Lock & File Encryption (playground.develop.applocker). Play Store listing not currently available.
Telegram-fork messenger (org.potatochat.PotatoEnterprise / org.potato.messenger). Apple US listing removed; Android typically sideloaded, not on Play.

Enchanted Cloud / Legendary Software Labs vault (com.enchantedcloud.photovault on Android and iOS). Play title Private Photo Vault; Apple title Private Photo Vault - Pic Safe. ArtiFast application key Android Private Photo Vault. Distinct from Private Photo Vault (Keepsafe). Pro package com.enchantedcloud.photovaultpro is delisted on Play.

CloudMosa cloud browser (Android com.cloudmosa.puffinFree, iOS com.cloudmosa.PuffinFree). Play title Puffin Web Browser; Apple title Puffin Cloud Browser. ArtiFast application key Puffin Browser (Android-only). Distinct from Puffin Browser Pro (iOS com.cloudmosa.puffin) and Puffin Incognito Browser (com.cloudmosa.puffinIncognito). MOBILEdit also maps Puffin Academy, Pro, Cloud Browser, for Facebook, and TV Browser here.
Tencent QQ邮箱 (com.tencent.qqmail / com.tencent.androidqqmail). Distinct from QQ messenger.
Xiaohongshu / Little Red Book, published as rednote (Android com.xingin.xhs, iOS com.xingin.discover).
Danish REMA 1000 self-scan app. Separate from the main REMA 1000 app.
Device/SIM hardware and telephony data (ICCID, IMSI, SIM SMS, etc.). Not a launcher app; kept for tool artifact joins.
Galaxy Digital Wellbeing (com.samsung.android.forest). Distinct from Google Digital Wellbeing.
Samsung Keyboard (Honeyboard). Preinstalled on Galaxy devices.
Knox-backed private space (com.samsung.knox.securefolder). LEAPP also labels one artifact "Samsung Knox History Log".
Galaxy Weather app (com.sec.android.daemonapp). LEAPP labels DB as Weather Clock.
Calculator-style vault (xyz.hypertornado.calculator). Current App Store title: Lock Master Photo Album. Distinct from Calculator# / HideX.

Private second phone number (Pinger). LEAPP artifact name: Sideline Chats and Calls.
Skyfire Labs mobile browser (com.skyfire.browser). Discontinued / removed from stores. Kept for Oxygen artifact joins.
Android SmartMob recorder (com.andrwq.recorder). Distinct from Apple Voice Memos and iOS “Smart Voice Recorder - Offline”.
Shared expense splitting (com.Splitwise.SplitwiseMobile).

Music and podcasts (Android com.spotify.music, iOS com.spotify.client). Store title Spotify: Music and Podcasts. ArtiFast application key Spotify (Android + iOS). Distinct from Spotify Kids and Spotify for Artists.
Encrypted messenger (com.twofours.surespot). Service shut down in 2022; no longer listed on Apple or Google Play.
Offline GPS by Sygic a. s. Android com.sygic.aura; iOS com.sygic.world. Distinct from Sygic Truck & RV (com.sygic.truck) and Sygic Travel.
The app doesn't sync data in the iOS backup so tools cannot parse from there. The data can be extracted from the web interface and is located in the 'IndexDB' found in the browser Dev Tools.
Free calls/texts app by TiKL Inc. (com.talkray.client / com.talkray.ios). Removed from Google Play in 2019; not currently listed on Apple.
Formerly Dubox (com.dubox.drive). Distinct from Box. Apple genre is Productivity; catalog uses Cloud Storage to match MEGA/Dropbox.

Pinger TextFree second-number app (Android com.pinger.textfree and legacy com.pinger.ppa; iOS com.pinger.textfreeWithVoice and older com.pinger.textfreeVoiceWithVoicemail). Current Play/Apple title Text Free: Second Phone Number. Sibling Play listing Text Free: Calling & Texting (com.pinger.textfree.call) is also mapped here via Oxygen/MOBILEdit. Distinct from Sideline, Pinger: Call Plus Texting App (com.pinger.pingerphone2), Text Me: Second Number, TextNow, and textPlus.

Flagship TextMe, Inc. second-number app (Android com.textmeinc.textme, iOS com.textmeinc.textme2). Store titles Text Me: Second Phone Number / Text Me - Phone Call + Texting. ArtiFast application key Text Me (Android TextMe * + iOS Text Me *; path TextMe2.sqlite). Distinct from TextMe Up, FreeTone, TextNow, textPlus, and Pinger Text Free.

TextMe, Inc. multi-number calling/texting app (com.textmeinc.textme3). Distinct from Text Me: Second Number and FreeTone. iOS App Store listing is gone; Android remains on Play. Cellebrite still has historical iOS artifacts.
Meta Threads app (com.instagram.barcelona). Store title: Threads. LEAPP “Instagram Threads” / “Instagram Threads Calls” are Instagram DMs/calls, not this app.
App formally called TigerText rebranded as TigerConnect
Bluetooth item tracker (com.thetileapp.tile). Store title: Tile - Find lost keys & phone.
Splend Apps SplenDO (com.splendapps.splendo). Play title is To Do List. Android-only. Distinct from Microsoft To Do, Todoist, Google Tasks, and GTasks.
iOS Accounts artifact named todo.snap. No current App Store listing for that bundle. Distinct from To Do List (SplenDO) and from ToDo Snap (com.tientruong.todosnap).
International Trip.com app (com.ctrip.EBooking / ctrip.english). Formerly listed as Ctrip; Chinese Ctrip app may share Cellebrite keys.
Travel itinerary planner (Android com.tripit, iOS com.tripit.tripitmobile). Distinct from Trip.com and TripAdvisor.
T Media Tech (iOS com.tmediatech.truthsocial, Android com.truthsocial.android.app). Distinct from Truth+.
Swiss TWINT prepaid app (ch.twint.wallet / ch.twint.payment). LEAPP module targets prepaid Twint.sqlite; bank-branded TWINT apps (UBS, ZKB, etc.) are separate.
United app (iOS com.united.UnitedCustomerFacingIPhone, Android com.united.mobile.android).
iOS WebKit Network Cache used by in-app WKWebView browsers (not Safari UI). Distinct from Safari listing.

Consumer WhatsApp (Android com.whatsapp, iOS net.whatsapp.WhatsApp). Store title WhatsApp Messenger. ArtiFast application key WhatsApp (Android + iOS; also includes WhatsApp Business artifact names). Distinct from WhatsApp Business (com.whatsapp.w4b / net.whatsapp.WhatsAppSMB), currently mapped to this listing in Cellebrite, MOBILEdit, and Oxygen.
Android store title is RAR (RARLAB); desktop product is WinRAR.

Encrypted messenger by Wire Swiss (Android com.wire, iOS com.wearezeta.zclient.ios). Play title Wire - Secure Messenger; Apple title Wire • Secure Messenger. ArtiFast application key Wire - Secure Messenger (Android + iOS). Cellebrite App Name Wire Messenger (iOS). Distinct from WireGuard.
Withings health app (formerly/also Health Mate). LEAPP artifact names use Health Mate.
